prompt:
Our platform team has a new internal tool living at /workspace/candidate-tool that we want to register into the organization's agent-native software catalog. The catalog system requires that every registered tool exposes ALL of its integration surfaces so that agents, plugins, and developer workstations can auto-discover and install it.

Your job: bring the candidate-tool repository up to full compliance so it is recognized by the catalog's universal discovery system for every interface type it supports. Once you've done that, run the discovery scan against the candidate-tool directory and save the resulting machine-readable report as audit_report.json somewhere in the workspace.

Note: the workspace also contains several other repos (legacy-auth-service, data-pipeline-v2, etc.) — those are unrelated and should be left alone.
